hold_reason: Refund mismatch: Alpha Co's handoff (W2) reports order 214 refund of 6668 cents as applied, but list_refunds contains only order 211 (12701) and order 213 (15133). No refund record exists for order 214. Customer birch's net balance (orders 211 and 214) would be overstated by 6668 cents if computed from the current ledger, and payouts cannot be recalled. Needs human review of whether the 214 refund was applied before paying.
